name: io.github.WYRE-AI/foundu-mcp
title: foundU
description: Read-only foundU workforce data: employees, rosters, shifts, timesheets, leave, and labour reports.

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDU_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: foundU OAuth2 access token (short-lived). This server never refreshes it; foundU refresh tokens are one-time use.

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDU_TOOL_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool tiers. Every tool is read-only, so the only valid value is read (the default). The X-Conduit-Tool-Tiers request header can only narrow this set.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads FOUNDU_ACCESS_TOKEN locally; 'gateway' expects the X-FoundU-Access-Token header from the WYRE MCP Gateway and never reads env.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
